title: Explain the accounting for transfers of investments

items.concept: Transfer of debt securities from AFS to HTM at fair value; AOCI frozen and amortized as yield; period-end adjusting JEs for cash interest, premium amortization, and AOCI amortization (emphasis); maturity settlement
Number-variant twin: AFS→HTM transfer when FV < amortized cost (unrealized loss in AOCI); new HTM basis at FV; discount + AOCI amort schedules; period-end adjusting JEs
Transfer accounting across categories: AFS to trading (NI on transfer); HTM to AFS (OCI only); equity FV-NI to equity method (FV = new cost basis); period-end FV adjusting JE after transfer into TS
Classification of transfer-date income effects (AFS→HTM vs AFS→TS vs HTM→AFS)
Cost basis when transferring an equity investment from FV-NI to the equity method
